title: SubmissionRequest
description: A proposal for creating a new article or updating an existing one in the Knowledge Base.

articleId.description: The unique identifier for the article being updated.

title.description: The proposed title of the article, which will be refined automatically. This is required for new articles.

content.description: The article content in plain text, expected to be in English and limited to 200,000 Unicode characters. This will be refined during submission. Required for new articles.

url.description: A reference URL for the article, used for informational purposes only.

metadata.description: Additional key-value pairs related to the article.

queryExamples.description: Examples of customer questions related to the article, such as "Why is my bill so high?". Defaults to an empty list if not provided.

additionalInstructions.description: Specific instructions to ensure responses are relevant and address exceptions.

AdditionalInstruction.description: Guidelines and responses to enhance the article.

clarificationInstruction.description: A guideline to improve the article's content.

exampleResponse.description: A sample response applicable if the clarification instruction is followed.

Metadata.description: A key-value pair providing additional information about the article.

key.description: The key for the metadata entry.

value.description: The value for the metadata entry.
